answer: An AI-agent economy can stem a Sybil tide via satellite-corroborated telemetry. Each agent anchors a vertex in a witness graph by signing local irradiance and surface-reflectance streams from a sealed sensor module. Verifiers match these curves against orbital passes and adjacent vertices, pruning duplicate or mismatched profiles. Fake identities thus require dedicated sensors, power, and physical sites, though cloud cover or spreading yarrow shifts reflectance and can reject valid nodes.
